(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (fill-row out r color)
      (let ((cols-hit (for/list ([c (in-range (cols g))] #:when (= (at g r c) color)) c)))
        (if (= (length cols-hit) 2)
            (let ((a (min (first cols-hit) (second cols-hit)))
                  (b (max (first cols-hit) (second cols-hit))))
              (if (all? (lambda (c) (member? (at g r c) (list 0 color))) (range a (+ b 1)))
                  (paint-cells out (for/list ([c (in-range a (+ b 1))]) (list r c)) color)
                  out))
            out)))
    (define (fill-col out c color)
      (let ((rows-hit (for/list ([r (in-range (rows g))] #:when (= (at g r c) color)) r)))
        (if (= (length rows-hit) 2)
            (let ((a (min (first rows-hit) (second rows-hit)))
                  (b (max (first rows-hit) (second rows-hit))))
              (if (all? (lambda (r) (member? (at g r c) (list 0 color))) (range a (+ b 1)))
                  (paint-cells out (for/list ([r (in-range a (+ b 1))]) (list r c)) color)
                  out))
            out)))
    (let ((row-filled
           (for/fold ([out g]) ([r (in-range (rows g))])
             (for/fold ([acc out]) ([color (in-list (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (row g r))))])
               (fill-row acc r color)))))
      (for/fold ([out row-filled]) ([c (in-range (cols g))])
        (for/fold ([acc out]) ([color (in-list (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (col g c))))])
          (fill-col acc c color))))))
